scenes.narration: Hello, and welcome! Here are today's top ten headlines from Tamil Nadu and India.
The Enforcement Directorate searched eleven locations in Kerala and Tamil Nadu.
Nine Chennai fishermen are missing at sea during Cyclone Murasu.
Tamil Nadu will form district taxpayer panels to resolve grievances.
Tamil Nadu mandated battery storage for solar projects above one megawatt.
Tamil Nadu limited Diwali firecracker bursting to two total hours.
The IndiaAI Mission introduced three indigenous AI foundation models.
The government proposed adding ten medical import gateways across India.
Keralam's Home Minister directed a vigilance probe against Gyanesh Kumar.
Delhi recorded an Air Quality Index of 379 on November fourth.
Adani Airports advised foreign airlines to shift operations to Navi Mumbai.
That's all for now. Follow us for your daily news from Tamil Nadu and India.
